items.definition:
Islamic religious law
Sharia law governs many aspects of life in some Muslim countries.

the absolute principle underlying the universe in Taoism
The concept of Tao is central to Taoist philosophy.

tendency to change rapidly and unpredictably
The stock market is known for its volatility.

a threadlike structure of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes
Each human cell contains 23 pairs of chromosomes.

a person's inherent qualities of mind and character; the way in which something is placed or arranged
She has a very cheerful disposition.

an overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement
She was in a state of ecstasy after winning the lottery.

a messenger or representative, especially one on a diplomatic mission
The special envoy was sent to negotiate a peace treaty.

the action or process of manufacturing or inventing something; a lie
His story turned out to be a complete fabrication.

the action of creating or preparing something; a mixture or preparation
The new drug formulation showed promising results.

a judicial order
The court issued an injunction against the company.

a genre of crime film or fiction
He enjoys watching classic film noir movies.

a substance with no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing drugs
The patient was given a placebo, not the actual medication.

the quality of being morally right or justifiable
He always acted with a strong sense of righteousness.

the state of being a virgin
The concept of virginity varies across cultures.

something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected
The discovery of a planet without a star was a scientific anomaly.

an opening, hole, or gap
Adjust the camera's aperture to control the light.

the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat
Protecting biodiversity is crucial for the health of our planet.

agreement or harmony between people or groups
The two nations lived in a state of concord for many years.

the action of keeping something harmful under control or within limits
The containment of the oil spill was a top priority.

the use of illegal performance-enhancing drugs
The athlete was banned from the competition due to doping.

a circular movement of water, counter to the main current, causing a small whirlpool
Leaves swirled in a small eddy in the river.

the practice of spying or using spies
The novel is a thrilling tale of international espionage.

practices, especially bribery, used to secure illicit gains in politics or business
The politician was accused of corruption and graft.

an external form, appearance, or manner of presentation, typically concealing the true nature of something
The spy entered the building in the guise of a delivery man.

a device controlling engine power
He pushed the throttle forward to increase speed.

a mass of whirling fluid or air
The water swirled down the drain in a vortex.

an assumed name
The spy used an alias to hide his true identity.

the state of being bound or enslaved
The country was freed from colonial bondage.

the process or state of converging
We are seeing a convergence of technologies.

the state of being objective or aloof; a small military unit
He observed the situation with a sense of detachment.

a neurological disorder causing seizures
Epilepsy can be managed with medication.

a colorless volatile flammable liquid, used as a solvent and in alcoholic beverages
Ethanol is a type of alcohol.

the process of international integration
Globalization has both positive and negative impacts.

the set of instruments used in a process or for a particular purpose
The new lab requires advanced instrumentation for accurate measurements.

unwillingness to accept views, beliefs, or behavior that differ from one's own
Religious intolerance can lead to conflict and discrimination.

a malignant progressive disease in which the bone marrow and other blood-forming organs produce increased numbers of immature or abnormal leukocytes
She was diagnosed with leukemia and began treatment immediately.

descent from an ancestor; ancestry or pedigree
He traced his lineage back to the 17th century.

a person who is killed because of their religious or other beliefs
He was hailed as a martyr for his cause.

sexual self-stimulation
Masturbation is a common human sexual activity.

the action of reducing the severity, seriousness, or painfulness of something
The government is implementing measures for climate change mitigation.

a reddish-brown heavy-scented addictive drug prepared from the dried latex of the opium poppy
Opium has been used for centuries as a painkiller and recreational drug.

a dangerous, difficult, or otherwise unfortunate situation
The refugees were in a desperate plight.

the action of driving or pushing forward
The boat uses jet propulsion to move quickly.

a skilled, experienced, and respected political leader
He was regarded as a great statesman.

a pig; a contemptible person
The farmer raised swine.

the criminal world; a mythical world of the dead
He was involved with the city's underworld.

disbelief in God
Atheism is the belief that there is no God or gods.

a helpful or beneficial thing
The new software has been a real boon for our productivity.

a union of states or groups
The European Union is a form of economic confederation.

the state of being kept secret
All patient records are handled with strict confidentiality.

the dispersion of any people from their original homeland
The African diaspora has significantly influenced global culture.

the state of being divine; a god or goddess
Ancient cultures often worshipped multiple divinities.

place; stead (used in 'in lieu of')
He received a cash payment in lieu of a bonus.

the availability of liquid assets to a market or company
The company faced a crisis due to a lack of liquidity.

a nobleman ranking below a duke and above an earl
The marquis inherited the vast estate.

the scientific study of the nervous system
She is pursuing a degree in neuroscience.

the support, encouragement, or financial aid that an organization or individual bestows on another
The artist relied on the patronage of wealthy collectors.

military observation of a region to locate an enemy or ascertain strategic features
The drone was sent on a reconnaissance mission.

a person appointed to administer a country because the monarch is a minor or is absent or incapacitated
The young prince's mother served as regent until he came of age.

An administrative office or department
The UN Secretariat is located in New York.

The characteristics or culture of Semitic peoples
The study of Semitism includes various languages and cultures.

One who kills
The dragon slayer was a hero in the village.

A person's height or reputation
He is a man of great stature in the scientific community.

The fact or quality of being different
There was a significant variance in the results.
